description: The plot illustrates the similarity of HSAs in different languages across various layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 24, and tick labels at intervals of 4. The y-axis represents the similarity, with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines, each representing a different language pair: en&en (English-English) in red, en&es (English-Spanish) in green, en&bn (English-Bengali) in blue, and bn&hi (Bengali-Hindi) in orange. The en&en line starts at a similarity of around 0.4 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 0.8 at layer 12, and then remains steady until layer 24. The en&es line begins at a similarity of around 0.3 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 0.65 at layer 12, and then declines to around 0.6 at layer 24. The en&bn line starts at a similarity of around 0.25 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 0.55 at layer 12, and then declines to around 0.5 at layer 24. The bn&hi line begins at a similarity of around 0.25 at layer 0, increases to a peak of approximately 0.55 at layer 12, and then declines to around 0.5 at layer 24. All lines are solid and have no markers.
